title: Pencil or Liquid?
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 11
Pencil or Liquid?

So many eyeliners, so many colours.
It is easy to hesitate.

Begin with the texture.
For a sharp, fine line — liquid.
For a soft line that melts into your eyeshadow — pencil.
Either one is right.

Then, the colour.
Close to your eyeshadow,
or black, close to your lashes.
Both have their place.

What matters is connection.
A liner should never float on its own.
Let it merge with the lashes, deep and dark,
or blend into the eyeshadow, in the same family of colour.

A little thought here,
and the eyes look more natural.
